summary: RoyaLand Co Ltd., a Bermuda-domiciled OTCQB-listed holding company (RLNDF), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 29, 2026 press release announcing that its Italian football club Savoia 1908 FC has worn Nike-branded kit since the 2026/2027 season opener under a four-season sponsorship agreement running through the 2029/2030 campaign, formalized via Nike authorized distributor GTeamGWear. No financial terms, fees, or share prices were disclosed. The item is an ordinary commercial sponsorship disclosure with no transactional, ownership, or capital-structure change, and no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is implicated.
